command:
cat > /app/meeting_scheduled.ics <<'EOF'
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Terminal-Bench//Team Planning Scheduler//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-meeting-20240117@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240117T000000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:1-hour team planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol
LOCATION:Conference Room A
ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:carol@example.com
STATUS:CONFIRMED
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def parse(path):
    evs=[]; cur={}
    for line in open(path):
        line=line.strip()
        if line=='BEGIN:VEVENT': cur={}
        elif line=='END:VEVENT':
            evs.append((cur['DTSTART'],cur['DTEND'])); cur={}
        elif line.startswith('DTSTART'): cur['DTSTART']=datetime.strptime(line.split(':')[1],'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
        elif line.startswith('DTEND'): cur['DTEND']=datetime.strptime(line.split(':')[1],'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    return evs

cal={'alice':parse('/app/alice_calendar.ics'),'bob':parse('/app/bob_calendar.ics'),'carol':parse('/app/carol_calendar.ics')}

def free(who,s,e):
    for bs,be in cal[who]:
        if s<be and bs<e: return False
    return True

def ok(who,s,e):
    if not free(who,s,e): return False
    if who=='alice':
        return s.hour>=9 and (e.hour<14 or (e.hour==14 and e.minute==0))
    if who=='bob':
        if s.hour<10: return False
        if s.weekday() in (1,3):  # Tue/Thu must leave by 16:30
            if (e.hour,e.minute)>(16,30): return False
        return True
    if who=='carol':
        if s.hour<9 or e.hour>17 or (e.hour==17 and e.minute>0): return False
        # lunch 12:00-12:30
        ls=s.replace(hour=12,minute=0); le=s.replace(hour=12,minute=30)
        if s<le and ls<e: return False
        # 15-min buffer needed after her meetings ending >= 16:45
        for bs,be in cal['carol']:
            if (be.hour,be.minute)>=(16,45) and abs((s-be).total_seconds())<15*60: return False
        return True
    return True

valid=[]
day=datetime(2024,1,15)
for d in range(5):
    base=day+timedelta(days=d)
    t=base.replace(hour=9,minute=0)
    while t+timedelta(hours=1)<=base.replace(hour=18,minute=0):
        s=t; e=t+timedelta(hours=1)
        if all(ok(w,s,e) for w in ('alice','bob','carol')):
            valid.append((s,e))
        t+=timedelta(minutes=1)

print("valid slot count:",len(valid))
for s,e in valid[:5]:
    print("EARLIEST:",s.isoformat(),"->",e.isoformat(),s.strftime('%a'))
PY
test -s /app/meeting_scheduled.ics && grep -q BEGIN:VEVENT /app/meeting_scheduled.ics && echo PUBLIC_CHECK_OK && cat /app/meeting_scheduled.ics
